proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

acToken().notice: Collateral Asset token address. address(0) for coinbase

acceptRebalance(address,uint256).notice: adds TPs to the bucket  called during a rebalancing process

addPeggedToken(address,(address,uint256,.notice: add a Pegged Token to the protocol

calcCglb(uint256[]).notice: calc bucket global coverage given an array of TP prices

calcCglbAndLckAC(uint256[]).notice: gets global coverage and amount of Collateral Asset locked by Pegged Token

calcCtargemaCA(uint256[]).notice: calculates target coverage adjusted by all Pegged Token's to Collateral Asset rate moving average

calcCtargemaTP(address,uint256).notice: calculates target coverage adjusted by the moving average of the value of a Pegged Token

calcLckAC(uint256[]).notice: calc amount of Collateral Asset locked by Pegged Token given an array of TP prices

calcLckACemaAdjusted(uint256[]).notice: calc amount of Collateral Asset available considering how many are locked by Pegged Token adjusted by EMA  given an array of TP prices

calcPTCac(uint256[]).notice: calc Collateral Token price given an array of TP prices

calcTCAvailableToRedeem(uint256[]).notice: calc amount of Collateral Token available to redeem signed given an array of TP prices

calcTPAvailableToMint(address,uint256[]).notice: calc amount of Pegged Token available to mint signed given an array of TP prices

changeGovernor(address).notice: Change the contract's governor. Should be called through the old governance system

editPeggedToken(address,(address,uint256.notice: modifies a Pegged Token of the protocol

execSettlement().notice: this function is executed during settlement.  stores amount of locked AC by Pegged Tokens at this moment and distribute success fee

getCtargemaCA().notice: calculates target coverage adjusted by all Pegged Token's to Collateral Asset rate moving average

getCtargemaTP(address).notice: calculates target coverage adjusted by the moving average of the value of a Pegged Token

getLastPublicationBlock(bool).notice: get the min or max last publication block among all Pegged Tokens

getLckAC().notice: gets amount of Collateral Asset locked by Pegged Token

getLckACByTP(uint256).notice: calc global coverage and amount of Collateral Asset locked by Pegged Token given an array of TP pricesgets amount of Collateral Asset locked by a given Pegged Token

getPACtp(address).notice: get how many Pegged Token equal 1 Collateral Asset

getTCAvailableToRedeem().notice: gets amount of Collateral Token available to redeem signed

getTPAvailableToMint(address).notice: gets amount of Pegged Token available to mint signed

governor().notice: The address of the contract which governs this one

isLiquidationAvailable().notice: returns true if bucket can be liquidated

isLiquidationReached().notice: If liquidation is enabled, verifies if forced liquidation has been reached, checking if globalCoverage <= liquidation

liqRedeemTP(address,address).notice: Allow redeem on liquidation state, user Peg balance gets burned and he receives the equivalent AC given the liquidation frozen price.

liquidate().notice: liquidate the bucket, settling the TPs liquidation prices and blocking all mint & redeem operations.

makeStoppable().notice: Switches ON the stoppability of the contract. It can be paused or unpaused  Doesn't change the pause state, if the contract was already paused it cannot be operated

makeUnstoppable().notice: Switches OFF the stoppability of the contract. It cannot be paused or unpaused Doesn't change the pause state, if the contract was already paused it cannot be operated

maxQACToMintTP(uint256).notice: gets the max amount of AC allowed to operate to mint TP with, restricted by accumulators

maxQACToRedeemTP(uint256).notice: gets the max amount of AC allowed to operate to redeem TP with, restricted by accumulators

mintTC(uint256,uint256,address,address).notice: caller sends Collateral Asset and recipient receives Collateral Token  `vendor_` receives a markup in Fee Token if possible or in qAC if not   Requires prior sender approval of Collateral Asset to this contract

mintTCandTP(address,uint256,uint256,addr.notice: caller sends Collateral Asset and recipient receives Collateral Token and Pegged Token  `vendor_` receives a markup in Fee Token if possible or in qAC if not  Requires prior sender approval of Collateral Asset to this contract  This operation is done without checking coverage  Collateral Token and Pegged Token are minted in equivalent proportions so that its price  and global coverage are not modified.  Reverts if qAC sent are insufficient.

mintTP(address,uint256,uint256,address,a.notice: caller sends Collateral Asset and recipient receives Pegged Token  `vendor_` receives a markup in Fee Token if possible or in qAC if not   Requires prior sender approval of Collateral Asset to this contract

pause().notice: Called by the owner to pause, triggers stopped state

rebalance(address,uint256,uint256).notice: removes TPs from the bucket and send AC to the MultiCollateralGuard contract  called during a rebalancing process

redeemTC(uint256,uint256,address,address.notice: caller sends Collateral Token and recipient receives Collateral Asset  `vendor_` receives a markup in Fee Token if possible or in qAC if not

redeemTCandTP(address,uint256,uint256,ui.notice: Caller sends Collateral Token and Pegged Token and recipient receives Collateral Asset.  `vendor_` receives a markup in Fee Token if possible or in Collateral Asset if not  This operation is done without checking coverage  Collateral Token and Pegged Token are redeemed in equivalent proportions so that their price  and global coverage are not modified.  Reverts if qTP sent are insufficient.

redeemTP(address,uint256,uint256,address.notice: caller sends Pegged Token and recipient receives Collateral Asset  `vendor_` receives a markup in Fee Token if possible or in qAC if not

refreshACBalance().notice: Refreshes the AC holdings for the Bucket

setOperationsFee((uint256,uint256,uint25.notice: sets operations fees values for each operation type

setPauser(address).notice: Changes the address which is enable to pause this contract

setSuccessFeeParams(uint256,uint256).notice: sets success Fee and appreciation Factor values.

shouldCalculateEma().notice: true if the necessary span has pass since last ema update

swapTCforTP(address,uint256,uint256,uint.notice: Caller sends a Collateral Token and recipient receives Pegged Token.  `vendor_` receives a markup in Fee Token if possible or in qAC if not.

swapTPforTC(address,uint256,uint256,uint.notice: caller sends a Pegged Token and recipient receives Collateral Token  `vendor_` receives a markup in Fee Token if possible or in qAC if not

swapTPforTP(address,address,uint256,uint.notice: caller sends a Pegged Token and recipient receives another one  `vendor_` receives a markup in Fee Token if possible or in qAC if not

tcHoldersInterestPayment().notice: executes the interest payment of the TC holders  can only be executed after `tcInterestPaymentTimeSpan`

unpause().notice: Called by the owner to unpause, returns to normal state

updateEmas().notice: If time, calculates the EMA for all the Pegged Token prices.
